about.heading: About me
about.intro:
I am an IT systems engineer in Dhaka with a background in electrical engineering. Since 2013 I have worked across newspaper, power, retail and data teams, and that range shows in how I work: I plan carefully, test before I deploy, and keep systems running.

Today I look after servers, Active Directory, networks and end-user support for a national daily newspaper, including its e-paper publishing workflow. Outside work I build web products with AI-assisted development, such as Likhon Tools, a bilingual Bangla/English tools platform.
